tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background, behind the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Main area, cards, tables and inputs.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Pressed faces, bar tracks, disabled buttons and inline code.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers, input and card borders, table row rules.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (secondary button, command input, key controls) and the offline lamp. 3:1 or more on surface.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body text on bg, surface and sunk.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata and placeholders on bg, surface and sunk.

tokens.name: walle-orange
tokens.usage: WALL·E fill for the primary button (Apply, Run). Text on it is on-walle. Lightened from the source #E0521F to get 4.5:1 with on-walle.

tokens.name: on-walle
tokens.usage: Text and icons on walle-orange and walle-yellow fills. Never white.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: WALL·E accent text: warnings, over budget, Real problem. On surface, bg and rust-soft.

tokens.name: rust-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind rust text (walle badge, warning rows).

tokens.name: walle-yellow
tokens.usage: WALL·E body yellow. Large fills only (empty-state mark, scan cubes, cover). Text on it is on-walle.

tokens.name: trim
tokens.usage: Yellow-family text: items to trim, the FIX label, highlights. On surface and trim-soft.

tokens.name: trim-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind trim text.

tokens.name: eve
tokens.usage: EVE blue text: links, measured values, file:line locations, selection, focus ring, running lamp. On bg, surface, sunk and eve-soft.

tokens.name: eve-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind eve text (eve badge, selected list row, loaded share of a usage bar).

tokens.name: eve-glow
tokens.usage: EVE eye fill: running and measuring marks, the EVE mark. Text on it is on-glow.

tokens.name: on-glow
tokens.usage: Text on an eve-glow fill.

tokens.name: eve-shell
tokens.usage: EVE white body: the EVE mark, floating menus.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Seedling fill: online lamp, kept items, finished steps. Text in this role is lean. 3:1 or more on surface.

tokens.name: lean
tokens.usage: Success and kept text. On surface and lean-soft. Close in lightness to rust, so a status always carries a word.

tokens.name: lean-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind lean text.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links. Alias of eve. The source report.html used rust; reading and measuring moved to EVE blue.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and destructive text. Alias of rust, so it always carries a word (Error, Delete).

tokens.name: chart-host
tokens.usage: Chart category 1: host and other (system prompt, built-in tools). Category order 1-2-3-4 is fixed. Passes validate_palette in light and dark.

tokens.name: chart-skills
tokens.usage: Chart category 2: skill list.

tokens.name: chart-mcp
tokens.usage: Chart category 3: MCP and tools.

tokens.name: chart-instr
tokens.usage: Chart category 4: instruction files. 2.33:1 on surface in light, so the legend and table always go with it.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "D2Coding", "Noto Sans Mono CJK KR", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.sample: This folder has no scan yet.
styles.usage: First line of an empty or waiting screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Subheads in panels, settings group names.

styles.name: chat
styles.sample: Merge the two lines into 'Run the tests with pytest -q'.
styles.usage: Long text an agent wrote. The FIX line of JudgeAnswer uses body.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary text, list and table rows.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Table footnotes, the source of a number.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The product name, in place of a logo. Always lowercase.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Key-control labels and section heads. Set in uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, paths, token counts. Numbers use tabular-nums.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its text; vertical padding in badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge side padding, gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap in button groups, padding inside inputs.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between list groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen side margins, gap between large groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top margin of empty and waiting screens.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Status plates, small ticks, scan cubes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, command input, key controls, judge target rows (as in the source).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Badges and tags.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, CommandBar, JudgeAnswer (as in the source).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status lamps and the EVE mark.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Floating menus, popovers and tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: Bottom face of key-style secondary buttons (line-strong color).
